mechanism_narrative: A rising GDPC1 indicates strong economic demand, which should positively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth is strong but S&P 500 returns are negative over 20 days, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in UNRATE suggests labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increases by 0.2pp in one month
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases but S&P 500 returns are positive, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL increases and FEDFUNDS is low, inflation may prompt tighter monetary policy, negatively impacting S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increases and FEDFUNDS is below 0.1
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL rises with low FEDFUNDS but S&P 500 returns are positive, this hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: Rising INDPRO indicates increased production, signaling economic strength and positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO grows but S&P 500 returns are negative, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing HOUST suggests strong housing demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If HOUST rises but S&P 500 returns are negative, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A drop in RSAFS indicates reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS drops but S&P 500 returns are positive, this hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: If PAYEMS increases while UNRATE also rises, it may indicate inefficiencies, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If both PAYEMS and UNRATE increase but S&P 500 returns are positive, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Slowing GDPC1 growth in late expansion may signal a downturn, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth slows but S&P 500 returns are positive, this hypothesis is falsified.
